reason: The integration runner requires seeded Supabase API, database, Auth and Edge services. CI currently replays the database and runs pgTAP. Live provider certification also requires isolated provider accounts and credentials (#134).
Signed-in Console and Portal scenarios need an isolated backend and role fixtures. The post-DEV report runs the anonymous subset (#116, #130).
The invite scenarios require isolated tenant Auth fixtures and email delivery capture (#130).
FieldOps browser suites need the app runtime, isolated Supabase and seeded driver accounts (#130).
The native Detox configuration needs a built FieldOps Android app, an emulator and a disposable backend.
The Console V2 E2E configuration needs seed and live fixtures, local app startup and a separately provisioned backend for live readiness.
Visual baseline capture requires an audited fixture, browser and reference-image setup. The regeneration workflow is opt-in and has separate prerequisites.
Load tests need an isolated target with generated data and a planned rate budget (#135).
These entry points require deployed Edge functions, service credentials and isolated QA case fixtures.
Rollback tests need a disposable database replayed to the exact migration boundary, followed by an inverse and refusal check.
Existing CI exclusion while the capability extractor reports command IDs and tracking labels as capabilities (#112).
